source: https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice.md, section "A more complex example", read on 2026-10-11
written: The request and the documented answer are TypeSafe's. Claude Opus 5.5 wrote the 24 issues on 2026-10-11, 8 for each team of TypeSafe's question, each about one team only.

typesafe_request.state: Shoes arrived two weeks late and in the wrong size. Also I see two charges of $120 on my card. What are you going to do about this?

return_reason.instructions: If the customer wants to return something, why?

criteria.damaged: The item arrived broken or faulty
criteria.changed_mind: The item is fine, the customer no longer wants it
criteria.other: A return reason that fits none of the above

shipping_issue.instructions: If this is a shipping problem, which kind is it?

criteria.delayed: The package is late but still on its way
criteria.wrong_address: The package went to the wrong place
criteria.other: A shipping problem that fits none of the above

requested_resolution.instructions: What does the customer want to happen?

criteria.exchange: Swap the item for a different one
criteria.information: Just an answer, no action needed
